name: Redbacked Cutworm
desc: Redbacked Cutworm (Euxoa ochrogaster): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 11 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Euxoa ochrogaster, the red-backed cutworm, is a moth of the family Noctuidae. It is found from Iceland and northern Europe, through the Baltic to the Amur region.
